opening.argument: The title directs viewers to WhatsApp "to work on the Forsage BUSD platform," and the displayed Forsage BUSD material sets out tiered programs linking income to direct partners and team development. Account screens reinforce that solicitation by showing personal referral links, partner and team counts, and BUSD profit figures. Together, these features present participation in a network-marketing structure where earnings are tied to recruitment and team growth. The screens establish what the account displays, but they do not establish that the earnings were authentic or withdrawn. The record also does not show that viewers paid money or suffered losses.
